answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted voting on attestations: an agent's say over who gets confirmed is proportional to the capital it has bonded, never to how many identities it spins up. Split a single walnut of stake across a thousand sybils and each holds only 1/1000th the weight, a sable sliver, so their pooled voice never exceeds that one original deposit. To actually move an outcome a swarm must buy fresh stake at full price, and any dishonest vote burns an umber stain into the bond through slashing. Influence is conserved, so multiplying identities earns nothing.
